concerns.text: The plan references an independent external hold‑out test set sourced from the DOE Materials Data Repository (DOI:, version 2024‑01‑01) but provides no concrete citation, URL, or verified accession ID. This violates FR‑010 and Constitution Principle VII, which require a documented, reachable dataset for independent validation.

Performing 1,000 full‑pipeline bootstrap refits (including imputation, scaling, and model training) on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ~7 GB RAM) is unlikely to complete within the 6 h wall‑clock budget. The compute demand exceeds the free‑compute constraints of llmXive, making the analysis infeasible as written.
